3532-5078-7736-8176.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2724-5775-8172.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
2724-5775-8172.description:
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping the creature you want to blink, saddling Fortune.
Declare Fortune as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot kill it in combat.
When Fortune attacks, it triggers, creating a delayed triggered ability.
At end of combat, Fortune's delayed triggered ability resolves, blinking it and Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

1011-2728-5256-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5256-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5256-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

872-3861-7857.description:

When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.

Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

413-7124-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7279.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.

When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1069-5285-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5499-7297.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

283-2872-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
283-2872-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

5864-6006-7110-7111.notablePrerequisites: You control four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats that do not have summoning sickness.
5864-6006-7110-7111.description:
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Get Out by paying {U}{U}, targeting Stormchaser's Talent. Stormchaser's Talent's first ability, Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve the Stormchaser Talent trigger, creating a 1/1 Otter creature token with prowess.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Get Out, returning Stormchaser's Talent from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Stormchaser's Talent by paying {U}. Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Stormchaser's Talent by paying {3}{U}, causing it to gain level 2. It then triggers, returning Get Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

109-232-1235-1309.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.

Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1267-4962-5406.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.

1118-1769-2201-4924.description:

When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
